notes: Adds GET /api/services/{id} - looks up one already-known service by its real numeric id directly (e.g. for a checkout/order-confirmation page that only has the id, not the category slug), returning the exact same field shape as GET /api/services' list items (id, name, description, rate, rate_formatted, min, max, refill, cancel, is_geo, start_source) plus which landing category it belongs to. Same public/CORS boundary and curation rule as the list endpoint: only a service currently matched by an active Landing Category is exposed, 404 otherwise (id doesn't exist, unavailable, or simply not wired to any landing category - indistinguishable by design). SEO > Catalog Services' Language filter now also switches the Category column to match the selected language, same as Name/Description/Status. Fixes Landing Category matching being unreliable across languages: match_text is checked ONLY against a service's English and site-default-language category/name, never whatever single language the pricing API's account happens to return. The Catalog pricing sync API server (SEO > Settings) is picked from your existing Free Service Gateway > API Servers list. Also corrects the earlier 1.27.30 update, which broke the Analytics page - this build includes all of 1.28-1.31's analytics/purchase-tracking/Telegram-view-top-up work intact. Requires 'Update database' for two new tables (catalog_services, landing_service_categories).
